limitations: Metrics are eventual observations and do not independently prove account cleanup or empty-table erasure.
Alarm history Action Succeeded establishes CloudWatch action acceptance, not support inbox receipt.
SNS delivered/failed metrics are topic aggregates; they do not identify a particular email recipient or correlate one message exactly.
A previous ALARM is retained as history even if current state is OK; a source fix is not declared recovered until post-fix success metrics or the root runtime evidence support it.
